summary: Health is broken down by clinical and administrative function, not by setting, specialty or vendor suite. The WHO Classification of Digital Health Interventions (health-worker, person, system-manager and data-service groups) and the ISO/HL7 EHR System Functional Model (care provision, care support, population health, administration, infrastructure) set the top-level cut. ONC certification criteria, IHE domains, DICOM, CDISC and the WHO ICF set the tasks inside it. An EHR or practice-management suite appears as an example under many nodes; specialty and veterinary systems are examples of the same functions.

capabilities.notes: New capability, from WHO's data-services group and the EHR model's infrastructure sections. General integration middleware stays in computing; the health-specific message standards, terminologies and de-identification rules are here.

tasks.name: Clinical message translation and routing
tasks.definition: Given clinical messages and resources (HL7 v2, FHIR, proprietary), validate, transform and route them between systems.
tasks.inputs: inbound messages, mapping specifications, routing rules
tasks.outputs: transformed and routed messages, error queues

crosswalk.scheme: WHO Classification of Digital Health Interventions v1.0 (2018)
crosswalk.label: Data exchange and interoperability

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: HL7 and FHIR validators give pass/fail conformance; mapping semantics need reviewed examples.

tasks.name: Care summary document exchange
tasks.definition: Given a patient record, generate a standard care summary (C-CDA, International Patient Summary) and exchange or query it across organizations.
tasks.inputs: patient record, recipient, exchange network
tasks.outputs: conformant summary document, exchange transactions
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: ONC C-CDA and FHIR validators give conformance pass/fail.

tasks.name: Clinical terminology mapping
tasks.definition: Given local codes or terms, map them to standard terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD) and across them.
tasks.inputs: local code lists with descriptions, target terminology
tasks.outputs: mappings with equivalence and confidence

crosswalk.scheme: WHO Classification of Digital Health Interventions v1.0 (2018)
crosswalk.label: Data coding

tasks.benchmarkable: yes: published crossmaps (SNOMED CT to ICD-10-CM) and the UMLS serve as gold standards.

tasks.name: Clinical record de-identification
tasks.definition: Given clinical notes, structured data or images, detect and remove or replace protected health information.
tasks.inputs: notes, structured records, DICOM headers and pixel data
tasks.outputs: de-identified data, PHI annotations
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the i2b2 2006 and 2014 de-identification shared tasks provide annotated PHI.

unplaced_products: Oasys structural design and analysis software
open_questions: The domain has 17 capabilities against the brief's aim of 6 to 14. Health is the largest need and the remaining merges (for example psychological assessment with rehabilitation, or orders with data exchange) would join unrelated functions. The editor should decide whether to accept 17.
Patient appointment and operating-room scheduling is placed in health (it is about patients), but the solver is the same as move's applied scheduling. Should the task point to move for the method?

Clinical NLP tasks (concept extraction, de-identification, coding from notes) are placed in health because the inputs, standards and benchmarks are clinical; science owns the general NLP methods. Confirm this split.
Patient-specific device design (surgical guides, orthoses, prosthetic sockets): health holds the clinical plan, design holds the geometry. Confirm the boundary.

Payer-side claim adjudication (Medicaid MMIS, workers' compensation bill review) was handed to govern under 'insurance'. Medical coding rules drive it; the editor may prefer it in health.revenue_cycle.

Clinical genetics is spread across nodes (pedigree in the record, hereditary risk in decision support, variant interpretation in the laboratory, pharmacogenomics in medication) rather than given its own capability. A separate capability would group the genetic counselor products.
Products based on unvalidated electrodermal or meridian measurement (AcuGraph, ZYTO LSA Pro, Electro Meridian Imaging) are left unplaced rather than modeled as diagnostics.
